200.description: CSRF token for cookie-authenticated unsafe requests

get.description: Returns only the authenticated user's applicable current document versions. Paper refuses onboarding unless every returned document is counsel-approved, published, and available from a credential-free HTTPS URI.

get.summary: List subscription plans and their immutable one-to-three-agent catalogs
get.description: Each assignment includes its exact closed researchUniverse, displayed to users as Available symbols.

200.description: Active plans with centrally managed versioned agent assignments

post.summary: Receive Sandbox App Store Server Notification V2
post.description: Verifies the Apple-signed outer payload and nested transaction/renewal JWS values against the configured Sandbox trust context before a durable idempotent commit.

200.description: Verified notification durably processed or previously processed

post.summary: Receive Production App Store Server Notification V2
post.description: Verifies the Apple-signed outer payload and nested transaction/renewal JWS values against the configured Production trust context before a durable idempotent commit.

200.description: Verified notification durably processed or previously processed

post.summary: Start a provider-approved in-app OAuth handoff
post.description: Fail-closed boundary. Returns 503 until an approved provider mobile contract and isolated server-side exchange adapter are injected. The authorization destination is exact-allowlisted and bound to one-time opaque state plus S256 PKCE; OIDC nonce is included only when approved metadata requires OIDC.

200.description: Validated authorization destination for an in-app authentication session

post.summary: Abort an unconsumed in-app OAuth handoff
post.description: Atomically invalidates unconsumed browser authorization state and restores the creator-session-owned pairing to pending. Connected, terminal, claimed, and callback-consumed pairings are rejected.

get.summary: Receive the provider-approved in-app OAuth callback
get.description: The callback derives tenant, session, and pairing only from authenticated opaque state, validates the authorization response issuer when advertised, consumes PKCE material once, and commits a durable pre-exchange tombstone before exchanging the code inside the isolated server connector. A provisional vault receipt enters a confirm_pending saga; only provider persistence confirmation permits account hydration and a connected state. The redirect contains only result and pairingId. Exactly one of code or error is required. Production capability remains disabled until the approved client metadata and connector are configured.

302.description: Token-free return to WHOX Treasury with result verification_pending, canceled, or failed and the opaque pairingId

delete.summary: Disconnect the broker account with server-verified device authentication
delete.description: Returns success only after the provider has acknowledged terminal authorization revocation; unknown outcomes return 503 and remain durably queued for retry.

post.summary: Revoke the existing authorization before starting broker reconnection
post.description: A replacement authorization remains blocked until the provider acknowledges terminal revocation of the prior authorization.

200.description: Provider-confirmed terminal revocation; reconnection may now start
Activated agents with current persisted configurations

post.summary: Activate an implemented agent for the user
post.description: The canonical configured symbol must be an exact member of the current plan assignment's researchUniverse.

201.description: Paused activation with atomic configuration version 1

patch.summary: Update an activated user agent and version configuration changes
patch.description: The effective configured symbol is revalidated against the exact current plan/catalog/agent assignment before any update is committed.

post.summary: Resume an activated user agent with server-verified device authentication
post.description: The proof is bound to this user-agent identifier and is consumed once. Resume fails closed unless the effective configured symbol belongs to the exact current assignment's researchUniverse.

get.summary: List runs for an activated agent

patch.description: Risk-tightening changes and exclusion additions do not require step-up. Any patch that raises a maximum, lowers a minimum, enables a permission, or removes an exclusion requires the deviceId and stepUpProof fields in the same body; that proof is bound to the exact resulting policy and consumed once.

post.summary: Preview a risk-policy patch and obtain its server-canonical step-up binding
Resume all user agents with server-verified device authentication
post.description: All agents are validated first; none resume when any effective configured symbol falls outside its exact current assignment's researchUniverse.

post.summary: Approve a trade proposal with server-verified device authentication

200.description: Orders with canonical mode and data classification

delete.summary: Unregister push tokens for the authenticated device
Close local account access and request broker authorization revocation
delete.description: Open brokerage orders block account closure. Acceptance closes local access and durably queues any required provider revocation; brokerRevocationPending reports whether provider confirmation remains outstanding. Records required by law remain restricted and retained.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Required for cookie-authenticated unsafe requests; bearer clients are exempt.

nonce.description: Raw nonce generated by the client. Required outside Demo; the server compares its SHA-256 hex digest to Apple's signed nonce claim.

signedPayload.description: App Store Server Notifications V2 signedPayload compact JWS.

researchUniverse.description: Closed, canonical-lexically-sorted available-symbol set published centrally and immutably with this exact plan catalog assignment. Only symbols in this set may be configured.

priceSource.const: StoreKit; display prices must be supplied by the client StoreKit response

productionApproved.description: Paper returns only true; explicit Demo may return nonproduction fixtures.

deviceId.description: Must match the device bound into the authenticated access token.

stepUpProof.description: Opaque App Attest, DeviceCheck, or WebAuthn assertion. The configured server adapter must verify freshness and the exact user, session, device, action, and resource binding.

deviceId.description: Must match the device bound into the authenticated access token.

stepUpProof.description: Opaque App Attest, DeviceCheck, or WebAuthn assertion verified by a configured server adapter.

deviceId.description: Required only when this patch relaxes the effective policy.

stepUpProof.description: Required only when this patch relaxes the effective policy.
